label: Admin
note: 10k orders behind a sign-in, sorted and filtered on the server, plus the shapes agents really write: nested loads, per-row loads, a slow panel. Canaries assume a page shows the customer name of the orders it lists.

canary.sql: update customers set name = $1 where id = (select customer_id from orders order by created_at desc, id desc limit 1)
